title: Page 4
content_zh:
可惜美男子费安不领情，还在众目睽睽之下调侃着人家小姑娘，语气有点儿吊儿郎当。“小学妹不必谢我，我是被某人逼迫，在大庭广众之下为显我翩翩风度，不得已才脱下来给你穿的。”

他看见舞冬末一脸尴尬的红。

“不管怎么样，我都谢谢你，费安学长。”她再次鞠躬跟他道谢。

“啧，有没有这么多礼的啊？我看小学妹居心不良喔。”有人在旁边起哄，引来数人一阵哄笑。

“我哪有居什么心啊我？”舞冬末的脸一阵红一阵白，只差没用力跺脚了，抱着盒子的手紧了紧。

“对上咱们S大第一美男子，哪个女人没居心？瞧瞧看她手里抱着的东西是什么？该不是要给费安学长的吧？那还藏着掖着干什么？不好意思啊？”

费安听了直笑，眼角勾勾的，只是睨着她。

“这不是给他的！”说着，她把盒子藏到身后。

众人又是一阵笑。“不是给他的？那给谁？”

“是给……我朋友的！”

“这里有你的朋友吗？小学妹？”有人噗一声不客气地又笑出来。“不会跟那天迎新舞会一样，你又在自以为是地瞎忙了吧？”

所谓坏事传千里，迎新舞会的乌龙事件自然也在校园里传开了，可传归传，也很少人见到正主，经这人一提，大家哗的一声又闹起来——

“就是她？把人家男朋友当色狼的那位？”

“就是。我亲眼看见的还有假？”

“天啊，没想到还有人会做这种事……”

舞冬末又羞又臊，转身就想走人，却被一个学长给拦下。“小学妹别走那么快嘛，让我看看你要送什么给你的朋友——”

舞冬末要闪已来不及，几个男学长联合要闹一个小学妹，一人在前挡一人在后抢，转眼间便把她藏在身后的盒子给夺去了。

“还给我啦！”她又急又气，伸手便要抢回来。“那是我辛辛苦苦做了一早上的……”

当一声，盒子在抢夺中摔落到地上——

装食物的玻璃盒破了，连带着盒子里的食物和她的心也和在碎片里。

舞冬末瞪大了眼，看着散落一地的各式各样寿司，倍感委屈，难过得说不出话来。她两眼氤氲着浓浓的雾气，感觉鼻头酸楚得要命，整个人气得颤抖。

为了做这些寿司，她可是花了一堆时间叫妈妈带着她去采买，又一大早爬起来亲自动手慢慢做出来的，为的就是要把她的心意传达给齐藤浅羽，感谢他那天的英雄救美。

现在一切都毁了……

她真是气到连想打人的火气都有了。

“你们满意了吧？这样糟蹋了我对朋友的心意，快活了吧？你们这些永远长不大的小鬼！玩弄别人很好玩吗？”她气得开骂，抬起头来扫视众人。“我舞冬末是哪里得罪你们了，需要你们联合起来欺负人？那天晚上我是弄错了，可弄错总比装瞎不管好吧？如果那个人真的是色狼呢？你们有我的胆识及多管闲事去插手这件事吗？还是假装没看见？你们自己心知肚明！”

说完，舞冬末转身跑开，一只手却在几秒钟后由后头抓住了她——

“放开我！你们还玩不够吗？放开我！”她大叫，不假思索地便想把那只手给使力甩开。

“是我。”齐藤浅羽淡淡的嗓音从她头顶上扬起。

闻言，她停止了挣扎，回眸，便看见一双温柔带笑的眼睛，方才所有的委屈竟在这一瞬间如排山倒海而来，气红的眼终是掉下一颗泪。

齐藤浅羽伸出手替她抹泪，温柔地睨着她。“傻瓜，哭什么？看到我就哭，我可没欺负你啊。”

“都没了……”她瘪着小嘴，咬唇再咬唇，忍着不哭，眼底却汪汪一潭泉水。

那模样，说有多惹人怜爱就有多惹人怜爱。

“什么没了？”

“我做的寿司啊。”

“对不起，我应该早一点出现。”齐藤浅羽很认真地道歉。“你愿意再做一次给我吃吗？”

她吸吸鼻子，幽幽地看着他。“你真的想吃？”

齐藤浅羽很认真地点点头。“嗯，下次找一个没有人打扰的地方，这样才没有人跟我抢食物。”

舞冬末噗哧一声笑了出来。“其实我做的东西不一定好吃，没人会抢的。”

“终于笑了。”他伸手捏捏她的小脸。“星期天去爬山野餐吧。我负责开车，吃的你准备？”

她愣愣地看着他。

他现在是在提出约会吗？跟她？

“怎么？你不愿意？”

“我当然愿意！我会很努力准备的。”她很用力地点点头，笑得一脸开心，不舍地朝他挥挥手。“那……我先去上课了，再见，学长。”

“再见。”齐藤浅羽温柔地笑着，目送她跑开，下楼，可爱的马尾在奔跑中晃花了他的眼，隐隐约约，他都还可以看见她唇角眉梢的笑意与欢喜。

“齐藤先生，你的行为很诡异喔。”一只手臂搭上了齐藤浅羽的肩膀，很自然地和他并肩一起往下看。“你喜欢她？还是不喜欢她？”

问话的人，正是刚刚在一旁跟他一样看好戏却没出手帮忙的费安。

齐藤浅羽眯了眯眼，目光往旁一扫，轻轻拨开了那只搭在肩上的手。“这不关你的事吧？”

“是吗？如果我说我要追她呢？也行？”

眉一挑，齐藤浅羽的冷眸淡淡地朝费安扫去——

杀气很重啊。

这一眼，跟方才看着舞冬末的温柔眼神大相径庭，像是两个人似的，一个似暖暖日光，一个似冰冷霜雪，这让费安不由自主地打了个冷颤，但脸上笑容依旧。

费安宁可相信那是错觉。

毕竟，他是浅羽在S大第一个认识的同学，他对浅羽的家世了如指掌，浅羽对待他虽谈不上热络，可却称得上是好友无误，至少在台湾，他可能是浅羽唯一谈得来的朋友，而浅羽在他眼中一直都是个翩翩君子，优雅迷人而且总是嘴角带着笑。

所以，刚刚那一眼，绝对是他眼花无误……

“我只是好奇，刚刚在走廊上的一切，你明明在教室里都看见听见了吧？却等到她被欺负透了才出来救她，这是为什么？”

为什么？

当然是故意的。

因为只有这样，她才会更是这些，他不会对任何人说。

“我又不是她的保镖，小事她都该自己应付，也可以自己应付。”齐藤浅羽微微笑了起来。“你忘了她的胆子有多大吗？那天晚上那位仁兄，可是长得高大威武又横眉竖眼，也没见她怕过。”

“这倒是。”费安点点头，又眯起眼。“就这样？没别的原因？”

“你是被人骗大的吗？一点都不相信人话？”

费安哈哈大笑，很用力地拍拍他的肩，结果这用力一拍，手却拍痛了，哇哇大叫。“你的身体是铁做的吗？痛死我了！”

齐藤浅羽好笑地看着他。“我没告诉你，我身上穿着铁甲吗？”

“天啊……真的假的？”费安夸张地看着他。

“当然是假的。”齐藤浅羽温柔地拍拍他。“上课了，同学，你果真是被骗大的……”

十月的阳明山，因为没花可看，人烟稀落，但清风徐徐，颇有一股秋的凉意，行走在小径上十分舒服。

舞冬末的背包里装了她做的寿司、水果、泡面、咖啡和热水，还有她爱吃的零食辣味虾味仙和五香乖乖，就像小孩子要出游似的，她开心地一下车便蹦蹦跳跳，浅羽伸手替她把肩上的背包拿下，很自然地扛在自己肩上，对他这贴心的举动，舞冬末的唇角露出浅浅的笑意。
content_en:
It's a pity that the handsome man Fei An didn't appreciate it, and still teased the little girl in front of everyone, his tone was a bit carefree."Primary school girl, there is no need to thank me. I was forced by someone to show my grace in public, so I had no choice but to take it off and give it to you."

He saw Wu Dongmo's face blushing with embarrassment.

"No matter what, I thank you, Senior Fei An." She bowed again and thanked him.

"Tsk, are you so polite? I think the elementary school girl has bad intentions." Someone was booing next to her, causing several people to burst into laughter.

"How could I have any bad intentions?" Wu Dongmo's face turned red and white, and she could barely stomp her feet as she held the box tightly.

"Which woman doesn't have any intentions when it comes to the most handsome man in S University? Look at what she's holding in her hand. It shouldn't be for Senior Fei An, right? Then why are you hiding it? I'm sorry?"

Fei An laughed after hearing this, and just stared at her with his eyes twitching.

"This is not for him!" She said, hiding the box behind her.

Everyone laughed again."It's not for him? Who is it for?"

"It's for...my friend!"

"Are there any of your friends here? Elementary school girls?" Someone laughed rudely again."It won't be like that day at the welcome party. Are you going about your business in a self-righteous way again?"

As the saying goes, bad things spread thousands of miles, and the incident at the New Year's Dance naturally spread on campus. But after the news spread, few people saw the real owner. When this person mentioned it, everyone started making noise again——

"Is it her? The one who treats her boyfriend as a pervert?"

"That's right. What I saw with my own eyes is still false?"

"Oh my God, I didn't expect anyone to do such a thing..."

Wu Dongmo felt ashamed and ashamed. She turned around and wanted to leave, but was stopped by a senior."Primary school girl, don't walk so fast, let me see what you want to give to your friend——"

It was too late for Wu Dongmo to dodge. Several male seniors jointly planned to make trouble for a primary school girl. One person blocked her from the front and the other snatched her from behind. In the blink of an eye, they snatched away the box she had hidden behind her.

"Give it back to me!" She was anxious and angry, reaching out to grab it back."That's what I worked hard on all morning..."

With a sound, the box fell to the ground during the snatching——

The glass box containing the food was broken, and the food in the box and her heart were also among the fragments.

Wu Dongmo's eyes widened and she looked at the various sushi scattered on the ground. She felt aggrieved and was too sad to speak.Her eyes were filled with thick mist, her nose felt terribly sore, and her whole body was shaking with anger.

In order to make these sushi, she spent a lot of time asking her mother to take her to buy it, and got up early in the morning to make it slowly by herself, in order to convey her feelings to Saito Asaba and thank him for being a hero that day.

Now everything is ruined...

She was so angry that she even wanted to hit someone.

"Are you satisfied? Are you happy that you ruined my feelings for my friends like this? You brats who never grow up! Is it fun to play with others?" She cursed angrily and raised her head to scan the crowd."Why did I, Wu Dongmo, offend you and need you to join forces to bully others? I made a mistake that night, but it's better to be wrong than to pretend to be blind, right? What if that person is really a pervert? Do you have my courage and nosy to intervene in this matter? Or should you pretend not to see it? You know it well!"

After saying that, Wu Dongmo turned around and ran away, but a hand grabbed her from behind a few seconds later——

"Let me go! Haven't you had enough fun? Let me go!" She shouted, trying to throw that hand away without thinking.

"It's me." Saito Asayu's faint voice rose from above her head.

Hearing this, she stopped struggling, looked back, and saw a pair of gentle and smiling eyes. All the grievances just now came overwhelming at this moment, and a tear finally fell from her red eyes.

Saito Qianyu stretched out his hand to wipe her tears and looked at her tenderly."Fool, why are you crying? You cry when you see me. I didn't bully you."

"It's all gone..." She pursed her lips, biting her lip again and again, trying not to cry, but there was a pool of spring water in her eyes.

That look is as endearing as it is adorable.

"What's gone?"

"I made sushi."

"I'm sorry, I should have showed up earlier." Saito Asaba apologized seriously."Would you like to cook it for me again?"

She sniffed and looked at him faintly."Do you really want to eat?"

Saito Asaha nodded seriously."Well, next time I'll find a place where no one will disturb me, so no one will compete with me for food."

Wu Dongmo burst out laughing."Actually, the food I make may not be delicious, and no one will snatch it."

"I finally smiled." He reached out and pinched her little face."Let's go hiking and have a picnic on Sunday. I'll be responsible for driving, and you'll prepare the food?"

She looked at him blankly.

Is he proposing a date now?With her?

"What? You don't want to?"

"Of course I am willing! I will work hard to prepare." She nodded vigorously, smiled happily, and waved to him reluctantly."Then...I'm going to class first. Goodbye, senior."

"Goodbye." Saito Asaha smiled softly and watched her run away and go downstairs. Her cute ponytail dazzled his eyes as she ran. He could still vaguely see the smile and joy on the corners of her lips and eyebrows.

"Mr. Saito, your behavior is very strange." An arm was put on Saito Asaba's shoulder, and he looked down naturally side by side with him."Do you like her? Or don't you like her?"

The person who asked the question was Fei An, who had just been watching the show like him but did not help.

Saito Qianyu narrowed his eyes, glanced aside, and gently moved away the hand on his shoulder."This is none of your business, right?"

"Really? What if I say I want to chase her? That's okay?"

Raising his eyebrows, Saito Asayu's cold eyes glanced at Fei An lightly——

The murderous intent is very strong.

This look was very different from the gentle look he had just looked at Wu Dongmo. They looked like two people, one like warm sunshine and the other like cold frost and snow. This made Fei An shiver involuntarily, but the smile on his face remained the same.

Fei An would rather believe that it was an illusion.

After all, he was the first classmate Qianyu met at S University. He knew Qianyu's family background very well. Although Qianyu treated him with no warmth, he could be called a good friend. At least in Taiwan, he was probably the only friend Qianyu could talk to. In his eyes, Qianyu had always been a handsome gentleman, elegant and charming, and always had a smile on his lips.

Therefore, that glance just now was definitely his dazzling look...

"I'm just curious. You saw and heard everything in the corridor just now in the classroom, right? But you didn't come out to save her until she was bullied. Why?"

Why?

Of course it's intentional.

Because only in this way will she become more like this, and he will not tell anyone.

"I'm not her bodyguard. She should handle all the little things by herself, and she can handle it by herself." Saito Asayu smiled slightly."Have you forgotten how courageous she is? That dear friend that night was tall and majestic and had an erect look on his face, but she was never afraid."

"That's true." Fei An nodded and narrowed his eyes."That's it? No other reason?"

"Have you been deceived? Don't you believe what people say?"

Feian laughed loudly and patted his shoulder very hard. However, his hand hurt when he patted him hard, and he screamed."Is your body made of iron? It hurts me to death!"

Saito Asaha looked at him funny."Didn't I tell you that I'm wearing iron armor?"

"Oh my God...really?" Feian looked at him exaggeratedly.

"Of course it's fake." Saito Asayu patted him gently."It's class, classmate, you are really deceived..."

Yangmingshan in October was sparsely populated because there were no flowers to see, but the breeze was gentle and had a bit of autumn coolness, making it very comfortable to walk on the trails.

Wu Dongmo's backpack contained the sushi, fruits, instant noodles, coffee and hot water she made, as well as her favorite snacks, Spicy Shrimp Fairy and Five-Spice Guaguai. Just like a child about to go on a trip, she happily jumped up and down as soon as she got off the car. Qianyu reached out to help her take off the backpack from her shoulders, and naturally carried it on her shoulders. At his considerate gesture, Wu Dongmo's lips showed a faint smile.
